name: EPIC 211330484
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 5, 11.3 solar radii and 1.13 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 211330484 (K2 campaign 5): PARAM radius (solar radii) 11.260889 (16th-84th percentiles 10.636864-11.618591), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 3,488 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 5, give 1.13 solar masses and 11.3 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,879 K at its surface.
